hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; ext="${f##*.}"; case "$ext" in js|jsx|ts|tsx) command -v prettier >/dev/null || npm install -g prettier; command -v eslint >/dev/null || npm install -g eslint; npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; py) command -v ruff >/dev/null || pip install ruff; ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; } || true
osascript -e 'display notification "Task completed" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Glass"'
